page.content:
Sword of kingship, given or returned by the Lady of the Lake.

How Excalibur connects

  • Character: King Arthur — Arthur wields Excalibur as the sword of his reign.
  • Character: Lady of the Lake — The Lady of the Lake gives Excalibur to Arthur.
  • Character: Bedivere — Bedivere returns Excalibur to the water after Camlann.

What is Excalibur?

Excalibur is Arthur's sword — sometimes the stone-sword, more often the lake-gift with a scabbard that stops bleeding. Bedivere's throw closes the reign.

Key threads lead to King Arthur, Lady of the Lake and Bedivere.
